listen_address.description: Local IP address the proxy will bind to. Use 0.0.0.0 to accept connections on all interfaces (not recommended for security).

port.description: Port number for the HTTP proxy listener.

socks5_host.description: SOCKS5 upstream proxy host (leave empty to disable).

socks5_local.description: Local addresses to forward directly, bypassing SOCKS5 (e.g., '.local,.example.com')

socks4a_host.description: SOCKS4a upstream proxy host (leave empty to disable).

socks4_host.description: SOCKS4 upstream proxy host (leave empty to disable).

forwards.description: List of custom forward rules. Each object maps a scheme prefix (e.g., 'https:') to a target proxy (e.g., 'localhost:8080').

target.description: Upstream proxy host:port to forward matching requests to

enable_acl.description: Enable access control list (ACL) rules to restrict who can use the proxy.

acls.description: List of ACL rules (only used if enable_acl is true).

filters.description: List of custom filter rules (e.g., for blocking or rewriting headers).

actionsfile_path.description: Primary actions file defining content filtering rules (e.g., 'user.action').

path.description: Absolute path to an extra actions file

obfuscate_user_agent.description: Replace the original User-Agent header with Privoxy’s generic one to reduce fingerprinting.

remove_server_headers.description: Remove the Server header from HTTP responses to hide server software info.

enable_https.description: Enable HTTPS proxy listener (requires valid certificate files).

https_port.description: Port for the HTTPS proxy listener (only used if enable_https is true).

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate for HTTPS listener.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key for HTTPS listener.

confdir.description: Directory where config and actions files are stored.

optdir.description: Directory for optional config files (e.g., 'templates' subdirectory).

template_dir.description: Optional custom template directory (leave empty to use built-in).
